lastResponse.text: Next step: stay on the line and I’ll connect you to a live two one one specialist now, and you can call on her behalf with just her first name. Tell them what you know: she left last night with kids, may be staying with a friend, and her phone may be off. They can walk through options for third-party safety planning and outreach.
